fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG) stock recovered above $300 but then declined near $285, with concerns over capital expenditure from $200B infrastructure investment and $1 billion additional investment in Anthropic weighing on the stock.
fields.summary_ko.1: Regulatory risks persist regarding search monopoly and advertising business antitrust concerns, and despite Google Cloud growth (30% cloud revenue increase) and new Gemini product launches, operating margin pressure and reduced free cash flow remain investor concerns.
